storage: STORE IN A COOL, DRY PLACE. ONCE OPENED, TRANSFER CONTENTS INTO A NON-METALLIC CONTAINER AND KEEP REFRIGERATED. USE WITHIN 5 DAYS.
note: Servings per package printed '8 approx.' at 50 g. No net weight is printed on either photographed face, so pack is unrecorded rather than inferred from 8 x 50. Every per-serving figure is exactly half its per-100g figure, which is the expected relation at a 50 g serving and was used as a check that the row labels line up with their values. 'Marketed by Pams Products' with a Palmerston North address runs round the curve of the can and is only partly legible.
